Hi Tony,

It is maybe complicated. My goal is to learn the models:

randomForest:
1. classification.
2. regression.
3. unsupervised.

With prediction 1 or many days?
With proximity?

Now I have found some examples. I can copy and paste into R but I would
rather use Rattle. If you have the time could you rewrite this tutorial so I
can use Rattle?

http://cran.r-project.org/doc/Rnews/Rnews_2002-3.pdf
"Classification and Regression by randomForest" p 18-22

Regards
Rolf
